Great to be in the heart of Downtown Orlando to launch our plan to make Florida the Most Transparent Government in America by expanding DOGE audits, exposing wasteful spending, and giving taxpayers direct access to where every dollar goes.

 As Governor, I look forward to working every day to protect your tax dollars and bring full transparency to every level of government in our state. 🇺🇸

Byron Donalds unveils plan to make Florida the Most Transparent Government in America

Spent the afternoon at @PortTampaBay seeing their operations firsthand.

This port is a critical piece in our state’s economy—supporting 192K jobs and supplying nearly half our fuel.

In Congress, I am committed to ensuring our maritime industry has the federal support it needs to keep our economy growing.

Thank you for having me, and I look forward to continuing our work together.

Had a great conversation this afternoon at The Getaway in St. Petersburg with Business Women for Byron. I loved hearing firsthand from the women who are powering our local economy and keeping Florida strong.

Looking forward to working with them to support small businesses across the state, and Defend the Florida Dream for every family.

Join us THIS FRIDAY, MAY 8 with Hialeah Mayor Bryan Calvo for the launch of Latinos for Byron.

Doors open at 12:30, we’ll see you there!
